_notes.dest: [x, y, w, h] in canvas pixels. A pane shows one crop of the Source scaled to fill dest.
_notes.source: face: largest dest-shaped window centred on the face. webcam: dest-shaped window webcam_face_widths x the face width, centred on the face. center: largest dest-shaped window centred on the frame. fit: whole frame scaled to canvas width, centred, black bars (dest is reduced to the fitted rectangle).
_notes.no_face_preset: Used when no face is found (the user is told).
_notes.multi_face_preset: Used for 2+ faces until active-speaker follow (cruxvid-b2t.14) exists: a single crop would drop people.
